panels.rationale: Coronal CT angiography (MIP reconstruction) of a human patient demonstrating long-segment coarctation of the abdominal aorta extending from below the renal arteries to just above the aortic bifurcation, with marked left renal artery stenosis, an atrophic poorly perfused left kidney, and extensive collateral circulation - findings the caption attributes to severe mid-aortic syndrome, a recognized less common (variant) form of aortic coarctation. Real patient image, diagnostic quality, no third-party copyright indicated; no annotations present on the image. [raw subtype: mid-aortic syndrome (abdominal aortic coarctation)]
